questions.question: Speed of five cars named as Vivek, Laxman, Kamal, Mohan and Ramesh are compared. Speed of Vivek is more than only one car. Speed of Ramesh is more than four cars. Speed of Mohan is more than Vivek but less than Kamal and Ramesh. Speed of how many cars is less than the speed of Mohan?
questions.solution:
Speed of five cars named as Vivek, Laxman, Kamal, Mohan and Ramesh are compared.

1) Speed of Mohan is more than Vivek but less than Kamal and Ramesh.

**Kamal and Ramesh speed > Mohan speed > Vivek speed**

2) Speed of Ramesh is more than four cars and Speed of Vivek is more than only one car. 

**Ramesh Speed > Kamal speed > Mohan speed > Vivek speed > Laxman speed**

∴ Speed of '2' cars are less than speed of 'Mohan'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"2".**

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers shares the same relationship in set as that shared by the numbers in the given set.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constitueut digits. E.g.13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(243, 81, 27)

(99, 33, 11)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

First number = Second number × 3

Second number = Third number × 3 

 
• 
 
(243, 81, 27) → (81 × 3, 27 × 3, 27) 

 
 
• 
 
(99, 33, 11) → (33 × 3, 11 × 3 , 11)

 

Similarly,

 
• **(27, 9, 3) → (9 × 3, 3 × 3, 3)**

Hence, the correct answer is **"(27, 9, 3)".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the sixth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number and third number is related to fourth number.

4 ∶ 66 ∶∶ 8 ∶ 514 ∶∶ ? ∶ 345
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:

Logic: **(1st number)³ + 2 = 2nd number**.

Now,

4 ∶ 66 

→ 4³ + 2 = 64 + 2 = 66.

8 ∶ 514 ∶∶

→ 83 + 2 = 512 + 2 = 514.

Similarly, for **? ∶ 345**

**→ 73 + 2 = 343 + 2 = 345.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

The logic followed here is :-

First number = (Second number - 2)¹/³

 
• 4 ∶ 66 → (66 - 2)¹/³ = 64¹/³ = (4³)¹/³ = 4
 
• 8 ∶ 514 → (514 - 2)¹/³ = 512¹/³ = (8³)¹/³ = 8

Similarly,

 
• **? ∶ 345 → (345 - 2)¹/³ = 343¹/³ = (7³)¹/³ = 7**

Hence, the correct answer is **"7".**

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some boy are strong.

II. No strong is weak.

**Conclusion:**

I. All strong are boy.

II. All weak are boy.

III. All weak are strong.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follows
Both conclusions II and III follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6115db57d183cba46d374bc924613639e4ccadc4a54256a019b3f1c616e67a63.png] 

Conclusion:

I. All strong are boy → False (Some boy are strong so, All strong are boy is false)

II. All weak are boy → False (Some boy are strong and No strong is weak so, All weak are boy is false)

III. All weak are strong → False (No strong is weak so, All weak are strong is false)

∴ Here, All three conclusions are false.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion follows".**

questions.question: Eight friends Mansi, Shweta, Monika, Payal, Aarti, Kajal, Laxmi and Rani are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Monika is second to the right of Kajal. Kajal is third to the right of Shweta. Payal is to the immediate left of Shweta. Shweta is second to the left of Aarti. Laxmi is fourth to the right of Shweta. Mansi is the immediate neighbour of both Shweta and Aarti. Who is second to the right of Mansi?
questions.solution:
Eight friends Mansi, Shweta, Monika, Payal, Aarti, Kajal, Laxmi and Rani are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). 

1) Monika is second to the right of Kajal and Kajal is third to the right of Shweta.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df890bf16995b14db948cc86e7c0438e06f6b908219af61f9c3862282bc45d11.png] 

2) Payal is to the immediate left of Shweta and Shweta is second to the left of Aarti. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39ad16054dbbb37c29e37e38fbecf07edf0fe410f32da4847eb63b8d37e95646.png] 

3) Laxmi is fourth to the right of Shweta and Mansi is the immediate neighbour of both Shweta and Aarti.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdc632b19fd987ebb508271c7b23302fc8e805dbd17bdab75ae97d9cd2cb1c3d.png] 

∴ Here, 'Kajal' is second to the right of Mansi.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Kajal".**

questions.question:
After interchanging the given two numbers, what will be the value of the given equation?

3 and 4 ; 3 × 7 - 8 ÷ 2 + 4
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Given equation is : 3 × 7 - 8 ÷ 2 + 4

After interchanging the two numbers 3 and 4 the equation is as follows : 4 × 7 - 8 ÷ 2 + 3

= 4 × 7 - __**8 ÷ 2 **__+ 3

= __**4 × 7**__ - 4 + 3

= __**28**__ - 4 __**+ 3**__

= __**31 - 4**__

= **27**

Hence, the correct answer is** "27".**
